libs1=dict(json.load(open('/workspace/run_trace/submitted_libs.json')))
libs2=dict(json.load(open('/workspace/run_trace/submitted_libs2.json')))
libs={**libs1,**libs2}
libs['PanglaoDB_Augmented_2021']='f9cad7b01a4721352a09f42df1e44719' # from first flat run
cands={
 'monocyte':r'\\bmonocyte',
 'dendritic':r'\\bdendritic|\\bDC\\b|cDC|pDC|plasmacytoid',
 'B cell':r'\\bB cell|\\bB-cells|\\bfollicular B|\\bmemory B|naive B|pro-B|B Cell',

 'CD4':r'CD4|T Helper|Th[0-9 ]|Tfh',
 'CD8':r'CD8|T Cytotoxic|CTL',
 'NK':r'NK|Natural Killer',
}
for lib,did in libs.items():
    r=requests.get(f'{url}/api/datasets/{did}/display',headers={'x-api-key':key})
    if r.status_code"'!=200: continue
    text=r.text
    try:
        rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text),delimiter='"'\\t'))
    except Exception:
        continue
    # maybe if output empty
    if not rows: continue
    print('\\n###',lib,'rows',len(rows))
    for cat,pat in cands.items():
        matches=[row for row in rows if re.search(pat,row.get('term',''),flags=re.I)]
